description: This file defines the RecipesProvider class, which manages application state related to recipes, filters, and search queries in a Flutter app. It provides methods for updating filters, toggling options, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: RecipesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that holds recipes and filter state, providing methods to update and persist filter selections.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clearQuery
methods.description: Clears the current search query and notifies listeners.

methods.name: toggleCuisine
methods.description: Toggles the selection of a cuisine in filters.

methods.name: toggleDiet
methods.description: Toggles the selection of a diet in filters.

methods.name: toggleTimeBucket
methods.description: Toggles the selection of a cooking time bucket.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to default and clears persisted state.

methods.name: setSingleCuisine
methods.description: Sets exactly one cuisine as the current filter, replacing others.

methods.name: _setFilters
methods.description: Private method to update filters and trigger persistence and notifications.

methods.name: _loadPersistedFilters
methods.description: Asynchronously loads persisted filters on initialization.
